title: Marcus–de Oliveira determinantal conjecture
statement: Marcus–de Oliveira determinantal conjecture · 1973/1982. For normal \(A,B\in\mathbb C^{n\times n}\), \(\det(A+B)\) belongs to \(\operatorname{co}\{\prod_{j=1}^n(\lambda_j(A)+\lambda_{\sigma(j)}(B)):\sigma\in S_n\}\). Marcus posed it in 1973 and de Oliveira independently in 1982 (survey).

counterexample.description: Give Gaussian-rational spectra a,b, a scaled Gaussian-rational unitary U defining B=U diag(b) U*/s, and a rational line that strictly separates det(diag(a)+B) from all 24 sigma points in the first-open case n=4.
